issues.location: enumeration supplying formula pairs to every natural-number branch
issues.finding: Worlds are finite sequences over Nat, and the recursive clause requires B_n and C_n for each n in Nat. The enumeration begins at one, leaving n=0 unassigned; content/sets-functions-relations/sets/important-sets.tex explicitly includes zero in Nat.
issues.proposed_resolution: Enumerate the pairs beginning with (B_0,C_0), then (B_1,C_1), so every natural-number branch is defined.

issues.finding: The source says to induct on the fixed prefix sigma when extending one-step inclusion to any accessible extension; the decreasing parameter is the length of the appended suffix.
issues.proposed_resolution: Specify induction on the length of the sequence appended to sigma.

translation_treatment: Translated sequence worlds, recursive prime extensions, accessibility and valuations, with zero-index coverage and the extension-length induction clarified. Localized both case labels and the concatenation explanation.
